examples.chinese: 我想友美喜歡白色，她常常穿白色的衣服。

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 今年你想要跟誰一起跨年？
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ kuànián?
examples.english: Who do you want to celebrate New Year's Eve with this year?

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡小動物，想要有一隻小狗。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān xiǎo dòngwù, xiǎng yào yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
examples.english: She likes small animals very much and wants to have a little dog.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ lèi le, bù xiǎng zǒu le.
examples.english: I'm tired now, so I don't want to walk anymore.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼你不吃冰淇淋？ B:因為天氣有點兒冷，所以我想吃一點兒熱的。

examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ bù chī bīngqílín? B: Yīnwèi tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yīdiǎnr rè de.
examples.english: A: Why don't you eat ice cream? B: Because the weather is a little cold, so I want to eat something a little hot.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有百貨公司，你想去看嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu bǎihuò gōngsī, nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
examples.english: There is a department store near my home; do you want to go take a look?

examples.chinese: 我想買一雙黑色的鞋子和一雙白色的襪子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng hēisè de xiézi hé yī shuāng báisè de wàzi.
examples.english: I want to buy a pair of black shoes and a pair of white socks.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

examples.chinese: 你不想坐公車，那(麼)我們坐計程車吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zuò gōngchē, nà(me) wǒmen zuò jìchéngchē ba.
examples.english: You don't want to take the bus; then let's take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 我很累，想回宿舍休息！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng huí sùshè xiūxi!
examples.english: I am very tired; I want to go back to the dorm to rest!

examples.chinese: 我只想喝茶，別的飲料我都不想喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hē chá, bié de yǐnliào wǒ dōu bù xiǎng hē.
examples.english: I only want to drink tea; I don't want to drink any other beverages.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: I caught a cold, and I want to rest at home.

examples.chinese: 我昨天開始咳嗽，現在想去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kāishǐ késòu, xiànzài xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I started to cough yesterday, and now I want to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我肚子餓了，想吃點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dùzi è le, xiǎng chī diǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: My belly is hungry; I want to eat something.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

examples.chinese: 老闆要跟我們談話，想知道我們工作做得怎麼樣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yào gēn wǒmen tánhuà, xiǎng zhīdào wǒmen gōngzuò zuò de zěnmeyàng.
examples.english: The boss wants to have a conversation with us; he wants to know how our work is going.

examples.chinese: 現在十點了，不早了，我想回家了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí diǎn le, bù zǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock now; it's not early anymore, I want to go home.

examples.chinese: 他下個月就要回國了，我想送他一些小禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yìxiē xiǎo lǐwù.
examples.english: He is about to return to his country next month; I want to give him some small gifts.

examples.chinese: 世界很大，沒去過的地方我都想去。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè hěn dà, méi qù guo de dìfang wǒ dōu xiǎng qù.
examples.english: The world is big; I want to go to all the places I haven't been to.

examples.chinese: 我已經坐了四、五個小時了，想出去走走！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zuò le sì, wǔ gè xiǎoshí le, xiǎng chūqù zǒuzou!
examples.english: I have already been sitting for four or five hours, I want to go out and walk around!

examples.chinese: 如果你不想吃飯，可以只吃幾個餃子。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng chī fàn, kěyǐ zhǐ chī jǐ gè jiǎozi.
examples.english: If you don't want to eat rice, you can just eat a few dumplings.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 我今天本來想去看電影，後來下雨就沒去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān běnlái xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, hòulái xià yǔ jiù méi qù le.
examples.english: Today I originally wanted to go see a movie, but later it rained so I didn't go.

examples.chinese: 我想先換衣服再去運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huàn yīfu zài qù yùndòng.
examples.english: I want to change clothes first and then go exercise.

examples.chinese: 美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。
examples.pinyin: Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.
examples.english: Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 我本來打算下星期騎車環島，但是颱風剛過，想來想去，還是決定不去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xià xīngqī qíchē huándǎo, dànshì táifēng gāng guò, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bù qù le.
examples.english: I originally planned to go around the island by bike next week, but the typhoon just passed, and after thinking it over, I decided not to go after all.

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 要是你想知道山區天氣的情況，上網看看氣象預報就行了。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng zhīdào shānqū tiānqì de qíngkuàng, shàngwǎng kànkan qìxiàng yùbào jiù xíng le.
examples.english: If you want to know the weather conditions in the mountains, just go online and check the weather forecast.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，孔子是地位最高、最偉大的老師，他的思想影響了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, Kǒngzǐ shì dìwèi zuì gāo, zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de sīxiǎng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén.
examples.english: For Chinese people, Confucius is the teacher with the highest position and the greatest, and his thoughts have influenced many people.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 如果你想了解臺灣社會的人、事、物，最好親自來臺灣住一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě Táiwān shèhuì de rén, shì, wù, zuìhǎo qīnzì lái Táiwān zhù yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: If you want to understand the people, events, and things of Taiwanese society, it is best to come to Taiwan yourself and stay for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

examples.chinese: 王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoxiānsheng niánqīng shí jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎojiā qù kànkan qīnrén.
examples.english: Mr. Wang left his hometown when he was young; he really wants to go back to his old home to see his relatives.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有一點兒累，我想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí.
examples.english: I am feeling a bit tired, I want to go home for a rest.

examples.chinese: 可是我只想聽音樂、睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng yīnyuè, shuìjiào.
examples.english: But I only want to listen to music and sleep.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
examples.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

examples.chinese: 妳想怎麼去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù?
examples.english: How do you want to get there?

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 是啊，我想買一雙黑色的。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng hēisè de.
examples.english: Yes, I would like to buy a pair of black ones.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 我們可以去問家樂，他非常聰明，我想他懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ qù wèn Jiālè, tā fēicháng cōngmíng, wǒ xiǎng tā dǒng.
examples.english: We can ask Jiale; he is very smart. I think he understands it.

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

examples.chinese: 我好想知道我屬什麼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiǎng zhīdào wǒ shǔ shénme.
examples.english: I really want to know what my Chinese zodiac animal sign is.

examples.chinese: 友美說她想去，我還沒決定去不去。燈會好玩嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi shuō tā xiǎng qù, wǒ háiméi juédìng qù bú qù. Dēnghuì hǎowán ma?
examples.english: Youmei wants to see it. But I haven’t decided to go. Is the Lantern Carnival fun?

items.wordHook: 想(to want) + 要(to want) → 想要 means to want to.

examples.chinese: 他想摸摸看這杯水是熱的還是冷的。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng mō mo kàn zhè bēi shuǐ shì rè de háishì lěng de.
examples.english: He wants to touch this glass of water to see whether it's hot or cold.

examples.chinese: 大衣、毛衣、外套等服裝，這家店都賣。學中文，聽、說、讀、寫等四個部分，都需要多練習。
examples.pinyin: Dàyī, máoyī, wàitào děng fúzhuāng, zhè jiā diàn dōu mài. Xué Zhōngwén, tīng, shuō, dú, xiě děng sì gè bùfèn, dōu xūyào duō liànxí.
examples.english: This store sells clothing such as coats, sweaters, and jackets. In learning Chinese, the four parts—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—all require a lot of practice.

examples.chinese: 今天晚上老闆請客，我得穿正式一點兒的服裝。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang lǎobǎn qǐngkè, wǒ děi chuān zhèngshì yìdiǎnr de fúzhuāng.
examples.english: Tonight the boss is treating us, so I have to wear somewhat formal clothing.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
examples.pinyin: Tā àihào huàzhuāng, chuān míngpái fúzhuāng, mùdì shì xīwàng biérén zànměi tā.
examples.english: She loves makeup and wearing name-brand clothes; her purpose is to hope others praise her.

examples.chinese: 大多數的模特兒都是腿長腰細的，穿什麼服裝都好看。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de mótèr dōu shì tuǐ cháng yāo xì de, chuān shénme fúzhuāng dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Most models have long legs and thin waists, so they look good in whatever clothes they wear.

examples.chinese: 旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
examples.pinyin: Qípáo shì Huárén zuì yǒu tèsè de fúzhuāng zhī yī, wǒ xiǎng dìng yī tào shǔyú wǒ de qípáo.
examples.english: The cheongsam is one of the most distinctive costumes of the Chinese people; I want to order a cheongsam of my own.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng dōu děi hǎohǎo dǎbàn, fúzhuāng yě yīnggāi jiǎngjiu.
examples.english: Generally speaking, to attend formal events one must dress up properly, and clothing should also be carefully chosen.

examples.chinese: 設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī lìyòng shàng diànshì de jīhuì, zhǎnshì tā jīnnián shèjì de fúzhuāng.
examples.english: The designer used the opportunity of appearing on TV to display the clothing he designed this year.

examples.chinese: 你剛剛說要吃漢堡，現在說要吃炸雞，到底要吃什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō yào chī hànbǎo, xiànzài shuō yào chī zhàjī, dàodǐ yào chī shénme?
examples.english: You just said you wanted to eat a hamburger, and now you say you want to eat fried chicken—what on earth do you want to eat?

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 我想趁著暑假去旅行，你有什麼建議嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe shǔjià qù lǚxíng, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì ma?
examples.english: I want to take advantage of the summer vacation to travel; do you have any suggestions?

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 要是你想建議公司採購新設備，可以上網填採購單。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng jiànyì gōngsī cǎigòu xīn shèbèi, kěyǐ shàngwǎng tián cǎigòu dān.
examples.english: If you want to suggest that the company purchase new equipment, you can fill out a purchase form online.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 他手上有傷，醫師建議他三日以內不要碰水，以免感染。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng yǒu shāng, yīshī jiànyì tā sān rì yǐnèi bùyào pèng shuǐ, yǐmiǎn gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: He has an injury on his hand, and the doctor advised him not to touch water for three days to avoid infection.

examples.chinese: 動不動就發脾氣的人，往往無法接受別人的寶貴建議。
examples.pinyin: Dòngbùdòng jiù fā píqì de rén, wǎngwǎng wúfǎ jiēshòu biérén de bǎoguì jiànyì.
examples.english: People who easily lose their temper often cannot accept others' valuable advice.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 火腿裡放了很多鹽巴，醫師不建議爺爺多吃。
examples.pinyin: Huǒtuǐ lǐ fàng le hěn duō yánbā, yīshī bù jiànyì yéye duō chī.
examples.english: A lot of salt is put in ham; the doctor does not recommend that Grandpa eat much of it.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 你老是批評別人，誰想跟你做朋友呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lǎoshì pīpíng biérén, shéi xiǎng gēn nǐ zuò péngyou ne?
examples.english: You are always criticizing others; who would want to be friends with you?

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

items.wordHook: Offering sharp 批(criticism) to thoroughly 評(evaluate) performance: 批評 means criticize.

examples.chinese: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōuwǔ yǒu shàngbǎi wèi jiāzhǎng huì dào wǒmen xuéxiào, yìtóng cānjiā quánxiào yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Next Friday, hundreds of parents will come to our school to participate together in the whole-school sports meet.

examples.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
examples.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
examples.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

items.wordHook: 特(special) + 別(other) → set apart from others, so it's special.
𦥑(hands) pull back a 冖(cover) from 爻(crossed sticks) and 見(see) leaves you 覺(conscious).
Combining 變(transform into) and 化(change): 變化 means change.
